detail.tagline: A bilingual mock of a soccer-school parent & coach portal.
overview: MateFC is a phone-framed web app that mocks the full experience of a soccer school's membership platform, in both English and Japanese.

It models two role flows — parents/students and coach/admin — across enrolment, attendance, billing, and academy/trial membership tiers, all driven by realistic static data so the whole journey can be demoed without a backend.
highlights: Bilingual UI (English / 日本語) with one-tap language switching
Separate Parent/Student portal and Coach/Admin dashboard
Membership tiers — Regular, Academy and Trial — each styled distinctly
Trial-to-membership conversion, attendance, news and billing flows
Built with React, TypeScript and Vite

images.caption: Bilingual sign-in — choose the Parents & Students or Coach & Admin flow

architecture.summary: A client-only React app with no backend and no database. Seed data loads into React context, and every action mutates in-memory state — so the whole product journey can be demoed, then reset with a refresh.

overview: An offline-capable progressive web app that turns 425 words collected since 2020 into a structured study tool.

It pairs a flashcard and quiz trainer with a themed wiki — business, idioms, Australian slang, medical, legal and social English — and the whole app is regenerated from a single JSON file by a Python build step.

Players fight endless waves of mobs, earn tokens from kills, and upgrade from a pistol all the way to a diamond cannon — playable with keyboard and mouse or with full on-screen iPad controls.

Weapon progression: Pistol → SMG → Rifle → Shotgun → Diamond Cannon

items.name: Talkio
items.description: A privacy-first iOS dictation app that turns speech into clean, ready-to-paste text entirely on-device, in eight languages.
items.benefit: Delivers fast, tidy dictation into any app — filler words removed, punctuation fixed — without sending a word to a server.

detail.tagline: On-device speech-to-text for iPhone and iPad.
overview: Talkio listens, transcribes and tidies your speech — filler words removed, punctuation fixed — entirely on-device, with no servers, accounts or stored transcripts.

Its custom keyboard brings dictation to any app: switch to the Talkio keyboard in a text field and speak, with the app relaying clean text into place. Built in Swift 6 and SwiftUI with zero dependencies, across eight languages.
highlights: 100% on-device — nothing saved, nothing sent
Eight languages: English, 日本語, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Português, ไทย, Tiếng Việt
Keyboard extension dictates into any app
Two-tier cleanup: Apple Intelligence + deterministic rules
Swift 6 / SwiftUI, zero dependencies

images.caption: Tap the mic and just talk — the home screen on iPhone

Swift 6 and SwiftUI with zero third-party dependencies

items.name: Wellbeing Navi
items.description: A private, on-device robo-advisor in the WealthNavi style — risk profiling, portfolio construction, Monte-Carlo projections and rebalancing suggestions for the family.
items.benefit: Brings robo-advisor intelligence to the family's investing while keeping every byte of financial data encrypted on your own devices.

detail.tagline: A WealthNavi-style robo-advisor that never leaves your device.
overview: Wellbeing Navi replicates the intelligence of a robo-advisor — risk profiling, mean-variance portfolio construction, Monte-Carlo projections, market-aware recommendations and rebalancing suggestions — as a private tool for the family.

It deliberately stays a decision-support tool (you place every trade yourself at your own broker), and all data lives in an AES-256-GCM encrypted vault on your own devices: a desktop app on the Mac, and phones over home Wi-Fi.
highlights: Risk profiling and mean-variance portfolio construction
Monte-Carlo projections and recurring-investment planning
Rebalancing suggestions that track the market
Everything encrypted on-device — no server, no account
Desktop app plus phone access over home Wi-Fi

images.caption: Creating the encrypted vault — all data stays on the device

architecture.summary: Every financial calculation runs in the browser, and the whole vault is encrypted with a key derived from your passphrase. A tiny zero-dependency Node server only serves the app and fetches market quotes.

flow.title: Passphrase unlock
flow.note: Derives a non-extractable AES-256-GCM key; the vault is decrypted in memory

flow.note: Risk questionnaire, accounts, assets and life events — all entered by hand

parallel.note: Scores answers into one of five risk levels

parallel.note: Fetched through the local server, with a disk cache and fallbacks

flow.title: Portfolio optimiser
flow.note: Mean-variance weights with anchors and drift bands

flow.title: Projection and rebalancing

flow.title: Re-encrypted vault
flow.note: Written back to local browser storage on every change

notes: Decision support only — every trade is placed by you at your own broker
No account credentials are ever stored; holdings are entered manually by design
Auto-locks after ten idle minutes, dropping the key from memory
Serves HTTPS on the home network so phones get the secure context encryption needs

items.name: 67 Mystery
items.description: A Brookhaven-style scavenger-hunt game set in a full Three.js city — dozens of missions tracking down the hidden "67", with shops, vehicles, outfits and crime events.
items.benefit: Gives the kids a Roblox-style world of their own — playable together on Mac, iPad or iPhone, straight from the browser.

detail.tagline: Find the 67 — a scavenger hunt across a whole city.
overview: A mysterious "67" hides somewhere in a full Brookhaven-style metropolis — downtown, mall, stadium, farm, marina, funfair, two climbable mountains and an island offshore. Read the clues, track it down, and strike the legendary 67 pose.

Forty missions (and counting) mix classic hunts with citizen interviews and random crime events; coins earned catching thieves buy bikes, boats, jetpacks and outfits, each unlocking bonus events. Friends join the same city through multiplayer rooms, and progress auto-saves in the browser. Built as a Three.js prototype to port to Roblox Studio.
highlights: A ~1200×1200-stud living city with townsfolk, traffic and wildlife
40 missions: hunts, citizen interviews, and thief chases
67 Shop: bicycle, motorboat, jetpack and outfits with bonus events
Multiplayer rooms — host or join a friend's city
Three.js prototype designed to port to Roblox Studio

images.caption: The title screen — the whole city is hiding something

overview: A kid-friendly, two-player co-op browser game where players climb the floors of their school, kicking soccer balls at a goofy zombie horde, collecting coins, upgrading gear and beating rooftop bosses.
It runs on two iPads over the home Wi-Fi via a small Node WebSocket server — no firearms, just soccer balls.

Climb floors, beat bosses, upgrade soccer gear
Kid-friendly — soccer balls instead of weapons
Runs on iPads via Add to Home Screen

items.name: Aussie Ramenman
items.description: A daily Python script that gathers tagged ramen posts from Sydney and Melbourne Instagram accounts into a Notion digest for manual review.
items.benefit: Surfaces fresh, relevant posts to engage with each morning, with no against-ToS automation on the account.

detail.tagline: A daily ramen-post digest delivered into Notion.
overview: A Python automation that, once a day, scans the tagged feeds of around 21 Sydney and Melbourne ramen accounts and writes the fresh posts into a Notion database for manual review each morning.
It deliberately performs no likes, comments or follows — it only gathers and reports, keeping the account safe from automation bans.
highlights: Scans ~21 Sydney/Melbourne ramen accounts daily
Writes fresh posts to a Notion database
Dedupes via local SQLite and auto-archives old entries
No likes, comments or follows — ToS-safe by design
Scheduled with launchd; Python + Notion API

architecture.summary: A scheduled Python script that only ever reads from Instagram. It collects tagged posts, dedupes them against a local database and writes the day's batch into Notion for you to action by hand.
